name: Garlic Rasam
steps: Soak tamarind in warm water and squeeze it well; roughly crush the garlic, pepper and cumin.
Simmer chopped tomatoes in tamarind water with turmeric, rasam powder and salt until the tomatoes collapse.
Add crushed garlic mixture and remaining water, then heat gently until the surface foams without boiling hard.
Crackle mustard and curry leaves in ghee, pour over the rasam and finish with chopped coriander.
tips: Crush garlic just before cooking for a fragrant rasam without a bitter taste.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
